column2: BlockID Business Passport, on Monad. Built for Track 4: trust, identity and AI infrastructure.

If you own two percent of a private company, today you own a PDF. Business Passport gives every shareholder a live share register on Monad, monthly updates drafted by AI and signed off by a director, and dividends paid to every wallet in one transaction.

Here is the flow. The company connects its data. Our AI pipeline drafts the update. The issuer service records it on Monad. A director approves it from a separate wallet, or a passkey smart account. Only then does Monad anchor the update and pay the holders.

This is the update the AI drafted for a demo company. Every claim is marked evidenced or missing, with an evidence confidence of eighty-two percent. Its exact bytes are hashed and recorded on Monad, but it is not final yet.

Step two. The director approves on Monad testnet. This transaction comes from the director's wallet, not from the service that recorded the draft. In fact, the contract never lets a recorder be a director, so the AI side can never sign off its own work.

Step three, the dividend. One transaction pays all twenty holders pro-rata: one point six three million gas, about point one seven testnet MON. Before any transfer, the contract checks the holder list covers the whole share supply, with no duplicates.

And here is the gate. We recorded a second update and never approved it, then tried to pay against it. BatchDividend asks UpdateAnchor itself, and the transaction reverts: update not approved. No money moved.
Anyone can check this without trusting us. The page downloads the update, hashes it in the browser, and asks Monad directly whether a director approved exactly that content. Pass.

Why Monad? Paying two hundred holders in one transaction costs about four cents. On Ethereum the same payout is about a hundred and seventy dollars at ten gwei, or two hundred separate claim transactions. And sub-second blocks mean the director sees the payout confirmed on the approval screen.

Everything you have seen is live on Monad testnet: the contracts, every transaction, and each holder's balance, read straight from the chain. The holders are sample wallets. There are no real users yet.
Business Passport. Know the business you own. Built on Monad. The code, the contracts and this demo are at monad dot blockid dot au.
